blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Tuesday said that it seized P62.8 million worth of suspected illegal drugs and arrested five individuals in three separate operations. Its joint operation with Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency and National Bureau of Investigation blocked alleged major drug shipments in Lanao del Sur, Pasay City and Pampanga on Monday, Oct. 26 in a one-day haul. Among those intercepted are approximately 10,089 grams of suspected ketamine packed inside a parcel at FedEx Cargo Area in Clark Freeport Zone, Pampanga.
